name: application-booking-confirmation-card
title: Booking Confirmation Card
description: Appointment confirmation card with a success indicator, title, date/time/host details, and Reschedule/Cancel actions.
useWhen: Confirming a successfully booked appointment, meeting, or reservation to the person who scheduled it.
Users need a summary of what/when/who alongside the ability to change or cancel the booking without leaving the view.
You want a clear success signal (icon + text) distinct from a generic content card.
avoidWhen: The booking isn't confirmed yet — use a form or `stepper-wizard` for the scheduling flow itself, not this post-confirmation summary.
Reschedule/cancel aren't available actions for this booking (e.g. past events) — drop the action row rather than showing inert buttons.
You need to show a list of many bookings at once — a `tables` or list layout scales better than repeating full cards.
responsiveBehavior: Single-column card; the date/time/host rows stack naturally and the two actions split evenly across the card's width.
accessibility: The success state is communicated by both an icon and the text "Booking confirmed", not the checkmark icon alone.
Date, time, and host details use a <dl> with visually hidden <dt> labels, giving each value a programmatic label for assistive tech even though it isn't shown visually.
Reschedule and Cancel are separate, clearly labeled buttons; Cancel's destructive intent is signaled via color, not solely by its position.
The host avatar is decorative (empty alt) since the host's name is present as adjacent text.

variants.title: Booking Confirmation Card
variants.description: Confirmed 30-minute demo booking with date, time range, host, and Reschedule/Cancel actions.
accessibility: Each detail row's label is programmatically available via a visually hidden <dt>, even where the icon conveys the same meaning visually.

variants.title: Booking Confirmation Card (Dark)
variants.description: Booking confirmation card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Success and cancel text colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
